fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Up to 40 characters, so the title fits the card on every screen.

validation.customErrorMsg: Keep the title to 40 characters at most.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description: Default: the white card, with the text and thumbnails beside the image. Cover: the image fills the screen, the items become colour swatches down the left (each item's Thumbnail is its swatch, e.g. a paint colour) and the title sits at the bottom. Two Cover showcases in sections one after the other (e.g. Exterior and Interior) get a switch at the top between them: give each a View name.

fields.name: classes_view-tabs
fields.label: Show the Views as Tabs
fields.description: Cover only. Set on the first view (e.g. Exterior). The Cover sections right after it become tabs on this screen, so scrolling goes on to the next section instead of to them.

fields.name: label
fields.label: View name
fields.description: Cover only: this view's name on the switch, e.g. Exterior. Up to 16 characters.

validation.customErrorMsg: Keep the view name to 16 characters at most.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Button link
fields.description: Cover only, optional: a button at the bottom right, e.g. to the car configurator.

fields.name: linkText
fields.label: Button text
fields.description: Cover only: the button's text, e.g. Build your own. Up to 24 characters.

validation.customErrorMsg: Keep the button text to 24 characters at most.

fields.name: media_thumbnail
fields.label: Thumbnail
fields.description: Required: the item needs its thumbnail.

fields.name: media_image
fields.label: Showcase image
fields.description: Required: the item needs its showcase image.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Up to 40 characters, so the title fits the card on every screen.

validation.customErrorMsg: Keep the title to 40 characters at most.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Up to 160 characters, so the description fits the card on every screen; longer text is shortened on the page. A paragraph, or a heading where the description is the item's caption (Combat page).

fields.name: hotspots
fields.label: Hotspots (+ points)
fields.description: Up to 8 bullets, one per + point, written as: x, y | TITLE | description (title up to 40 characters, description up to 200). x and y are percentages of the image from its bottom-left corner, and the + is centred on that point. You can drag the + points to any position in preview mode. A maximum of 8 hotspots is allowed. Cover style: link a point's TITLE to its photo in AEM Assets and the photo shows in its detail panel; the photos linked on one colour are used for the other colours too.
